downtime.detail: First open of an existing store constructs the checkpoint covering index synchronously before the API binds. Private eligible-row measurements took 1.99 seconds with 126.6 MiB additional live pages at 615,894 rows and 6.42 seconds with 205.6 MiB at 1,000,000 rows; full startup and managed writer return are excluded. Actual installation cost depends on row count, keys and storage.
